subject: Q3 Renewal: usage dip alert + renewal evidence sweep / action items
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Renewal: usage dip alert + renewal evidence sweep / action items

Team —

Quick hygiene ask on BrightByte (renewal target: 2026-08-21, DEAL-4721). Our usage signals show a ~22% month-over-month token drop for May; that's material enough to change our forecast if not explained. Can we run a short evidence sweep and log any churn risk indicators? Specific asks: 

- Naomi: can you attach the usage cohort sheet and call out which product modules dropped (in case it's product/feature related)?
- Marissa: please confirm the current sales stage in CRM and whether exec sponsor is still engaged. If there's been a sponsor change, flag as risk.
- David: from a finance perspective, do we need to adjust our ARR recognition assumptions if this goes to delayed renewal?

I've attached a one-pager checklist (stub) and would like to lock next steps by EOD Wednesday. If BrightByte has any procurement hold or budget freeze, mark as high risk.

Attachments: Q3-usage-trend-summary.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Renewal Ops | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal: usage dip alert + renewal evidence sweep / action items

Mina —

Uploading the cohort breakdown here (attached). Quick summary: the drop is concentrated in the Analytics module (API keys a12-*, a13-*), concentrated among 2 teams at BrightByte. Top-line notes: 

- Active seats using Analytics down 27% since Apr; embeddings calls largely unchanged.
- No obvious errors in our logs; error rates are flat.
- There is a 3-week gap in their billing reconciliation tickets (created 2026-05-03) which suggests they paused non-essential consumption.

I've updated CRM stage to "Proposal - at risk" and added an activity: outreach to sponsor (Sophie Martinez). Exec sponsor appears unchanged, but engagement frequency has fallen (last exec touch was 2026-04-10).

Attaching: Q3-usage-trend-summary.xlsx (cohort tab)

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Sophie Martinez <sophie.martinez@brightbyte.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbyte.com, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal: usage dip alert + renewal evidence sweep / action items

Thanks for the heads up, Mina / Naomi.

Quick context from our side: finance has imposed a short budget freeze as they re-prioritize spend for Q3. The product teams paused a couple of Analytics pipelines (internal) which explains the usage drop — not an outage or dissatisfaction. We anticipate a decision by 2026-06-28.

Two asks from BrightByte: 
- Can Redwood provide an itemized usage-to-cost summary by module for the prior 6 months (helpful for our finance team)?
- We'd like to schedule a 30-minute call with your renewals lead + our procurement on Wed 2026-06-23 to align timing.

I'll loop procurement on timeline and attach our internal renewal checklist.

Sophie Martinez
VP, Product Operations | BrightByte
sophie.martinez@brightbyte.com
Attachment (referenced): BrightByte-internal-renewal-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Renewal: usage dip alert + renewal evidence sweep / action items

Wanted to flag finance implications: if BrightByte pushes decision beyond 2026-06-30 we should consider moving $360k of ARR from "likely" to "best case" for the Q3 close. Action items for forecast hygiene: 

- Mark DEAL-4721 in the forecast as "at-risk" and reduce committed ARR by 40% until procurement decision.
- Produce the module-level cost export Sophie requested (Ops can run a query; Naomi, can you coordinate?).
- If we get a signed mutual-action-plan or a firm PO by 2026-06-26, treat as recovered.

I'll update the finance model after Naomi confirms the export. Attaching: BrightByte-MAP-v2.pdf (stub)

-David

david.kim@redwood.com

Thanks — all good context. Quick sync on next steps so we have hygiene tracked in one place: 

1) Naomi — please drop the module-level usage export into the shared Drive folder and ping Sophie directly (due: Tue 2026-06-16 COB).
2) Marissa — mark DEAL-4721 stage to "At Risk - Pending Procurement" and add the note: "usage dip due to internal pause; finance decision 6/28".
3) David — I'll leave the finance adjustment to you; please reflect the 40% reduction in next forecast refresh.
4) Sophie — we'll hold the 30-min alignment on Wed 2026-06-23, 10:00am PT; Naomi will send the calendar invite once export is posted.

I'll collect any further evidence and if we receive a PO or signed MAP before 6/26 we will revert to committed status. Marking this thread as the canonical renewal evidence thread for BrightByte.

Thanks,
Mina
